name: HappyToHelp
ownerSetup: Create the first owner at /setup using the privately delivered H2H_SETUP_TOKEN and connected owner email. The atomic setup claim consumes ownership once. Subsequent sessions use /login.
providerSetup: Selected model provider API credentials for AI features
Email provider and verified sender for outbound mail; inbound token/routing for inbound mail
Integration encryption key and selected GitHub/import credentials when those features are enabled
A separate Cloudflare website preview address is assigned automatically
The management service configures the owner/admin editor bridge automatically
operationalGaps: Source visibility and retained asset redistribution review must be resolved before public catalogue installation
Live model/email/provider acceptance is separate from build and /health
